name: Palace and Gardens of Schönbrunn
description: Schönbrunn is the Habsburg emperors' former summer residence in Vienna's Hietzing district, a Baroque palace of 1,441 rooms filled with lavish decorative art. Its name means "beautiful spring," after a well that once supplied the court. The sweeping gardens hold what is considered the world's first zoo, founded in 1752, and invite long strolls.
